articles.summary: At Blend, we’re always working to increase transparency and equity in access to consumer lending and lending-adjacent markets. The current technical ecosystem of consumer lending is disjointed. Much like bridges bring communities together in the real world, much of what Blend does depends on our ability first to construct virtual bridges (integrations) between these existing, disjointed systems, and second, to create a unified experience for our users.
articles.title: How we stopped wasting time building custom integrations
